_comment: Configuration for scripts/hardening-ratchet.sh. Keep metric policy in docs/rfc/RFC-OAS-023-hardening-ratchet.md.

removalTargets.direct_env_reads: RFC-OAS-023: reduce by moving runtime env access behind config/env boundary modules.
removalTargets.direct_env_reads_outside_env_boundary: RFC-OAS-023: target zero outside explicit envBoundaryPaths.
removalTargets.exception_message_classifiers: RFC-OAS-023: target zero after typed Unix_error/Eio/http_error classifiers land.
removalTargets.heuristic_markers: RFC-OAS-023/RFC-OAS-029: target zero for untyped heuristic runtime routing; new heuristic code requires a waiver and sunset plan.
removalTargets.local_workspace_path_literals: RFC-OAS-023: target zero; new local developer paths are never accepted without waiver.
removalTargets.model_id_string_classifiers_outside_cata: RFC-OAS-029: keep model-id string classification inside catalog/capability boundary modules; scattered model matching is SSOT drift.
removalTargets.base_url_host_fuzzy_classifiers: RFC-OAS-034: host/URL is transport, not capability provenance. New fuzzy String matching (starts_with/ends_with/contains/is_substring) on base_url/host is forbidden; bind vendor identity via exact Uri.host equality and capability via the model catalog. Existing ollama.com matchers are reducible debt (migrate to exact Uri.host).
removalTargets.stub_markers: RFC-OAS-023: target zero; assert false is excluded because it is commonly used for unreachable proof arms.
removalTargets.workaround_markers: RFC-OAS-023/RFC-OAS-029: target zero for permanent runtime workaround debt; temporary additions require waiver and sunset issue.
removalTargets.wildcard_silent_defaults: RFC-OAS-023: reduce by replacing permissive catch-all defaults with typed/default-explicit handling.
